messages:
maria_sales: ArdentPay asked for a one-page POC run plan + costs. Req: 99p <450ms at 150 qps sustained, handle 500 qps microbursts up to 45s, and confirm HSM/CMEK. Need quick turnaround.

devin_se: Proposed plan: prewarm 2m@20 qps; soak 30m@150 qps; 5m ramp to 500 qps; 3x1m microbursts@500 qps with 5m cooldowns. Workload = chat (prompt ~120t, resp ~250t). Run from east-us agents.

kai_perf: Config: model=rdx-large-quant, KV-prefix cache ON (10m TTL), batch window=10ms, max batch tokens=64. Trace headers enabled. Expect ~320 qps/GPU, so 1 reserved node + burst headroom recommended.

sam_eng: Ballpark (east-us): r4.x8g reserved node ~$9.2k/mo. Add amortized burst node ~$1.1k/mo. If they want guaranteed 500 qps bursts, reserve second node (+$9.2k). Will send CSV.

ellie_security: HSM/CMEK supported for Dedicated. Key unwrap adds single-digit ms. Need signed addendum and ops to enable CMEK. I can prepare legal bullets.

opsbot: [runbot] bench job=bench-176912 started; results -> /bench-results/ardentpay/1769123456.json

devin_se: Prewarm done (2m@20qps avg=85ms). Soak finished: 99p=405ms, P95=200ms, error rate 0.01%. Microbursts reached targets; autoscale ramp added ~250ms on first 10s. Full results & traces uploaded.

kai_perf: Recommendation: reserve burst node to avoid ramp latency for guaranteed SLA, or accept brief ramp penalty and route to fallback model (rdx-medium) during overload. I'll draft fallback paragraph.

maria_sales: Great. I'll send one-pager with run highlights, fallback options, and two cost tiers to procurement. Sam/Ellie: please attach cost CSV and addendum template. Thanks!
